dedupe_keys.name: enugu state citygml lod1 3d building model nigeria

description: This dataset is a city-scale CityGML level-of-detail 1 model of the buildings of Enugu, Nigeria, which its author presents as the first openly published semantic 3D city model for any city in sub-Saharan Africa. It was produced by Chukwuma Ugwu of the University of Applied Sciences Stuttgart (HFT Stuttgart) and published on Zenodo on 3 April 2026, using only open-source tools. Building footprints from OpenStreetMap, checked against satellite imagery, were extruded to heights estimated from a digital elevation model and contextual analysis; an FME workflow converted and enriched them into valid CityGML 2.0, validated in 3DCityDB and shown in CesiumJS within a smart city platform for Enugu. Coverage is the urban extent of Enugu, a rapidly growing city of about one million people that floods repeatedly. Access: open download from Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free (footprints derive from OpenStreetMap, which is under the Open Database License). Caveats: heights are estimated, not measured, and footprint completeness follows OpenStreetMap. Simulation uses are flood and heat exposure, solar potential and digital twin development for an African city. Related records: the HOT OpenStreetMap exports and GlobalBuildingAtlas.
